newsitem.title: USA: American Intl Kazakh may be 1.0 bln bbl.
newsitem.headline: American Intl Kazakh may be 1.0 bln bbl.

text.p: American International Petroleum Corp said on Thursday that reserves at its license in its Caspian Sea, in the western Kazakh section could be in excess of 1.0 billion barrels of recoverable reserves.
The company said that its engineers had found another energy bearing structure, bringing the total number tested to seven, with nine structures left to test.

The company's concession is 125 miles southeast of Chevron Corp's Tengiz oil field and is bordered an Elf Aquitaine license on its southern side and the west by the Oryx /Exxon Corp license and the Amoco Corp license.
The company said that production can be shipped via an existing pipeline.
Its stock was up 1/8 at 0-3/4 after the announcement, having been as high as 0-13/16.
Its partner in the concession is Germany's MED Shipping & Trading.

American International said that seismic data indicated that the untested area on the eastern half of the structure "could provide the largest potential deposit in the license area". ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
